scope: Candidate numerical references for an independently implemented primer Tm model; no product preset approved by this investigation.

plasmidstudio.inspection: Rendered public calculator in Chrome: selected KAPA HiFi; read displayed reaction inputs, example result, and generated Choosing the Right Polymerase table. No implementation code copied or fitted.
plasmidstudio.dntp_convention: The input label inspected does not specify whether this concentration is per nucleotide or total; leave unresolved.
plasmidstudio.displayed_ta_rule: Lower primer Tm + 3 degrees C, capped at 72 degrees C; table also applies the same rule and Na/Mg values to several other products.
plasmidstudio.claimed_model: SantaLucia 1998 nearest-neighbour with Owczarzy 2008 salt correction, per calculator documentation; implementation not independently verified.
plasmidstudio.provenance_limit: No source citation or experimental calibration for the KAPA preset identified in the inspected form, result or explanatory table. This is not an exhaustive absence review.
plasmidstudio.formulation_limit: Generic KAPA HiFi label does not identify ReadyMix, Fidelity or GC formulation. Displayed Mg differs from the Roche ReadyMix source below.
plasmidstudio.terms_observation: Software/interface/documentation are proprietary; copying/modifying/redistributing the service is restricted. Automated access beyond the intended interface is restricted. No open implementation license established; this record grants no permission.
plasmidstudio.decision: Do not promote to a verified KAPA reagent preset. Values are already displayed, so parameter fitting is unnecessary for identifying this calculator preset.

roche_readymix.document: KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix PCR Kit, KR0370 v16.25, effective May 2025
roche_readymix.inspected: Pages 1-3: product identity, final composition and annealing guidance; page 6: copyright and limited reagent license.
roche_readymix.buffer_composition: Described as proprietary; complete monovalent composition not disclosed in inspected product-description paragraph.
roche_readymix.decision: Retain formulation-specific disclosed concentrations and experimental guidance separately from any fitted Tm/Ta model. These facts do not identify a unique effective salt correction.

next_evidence_needed: Specify intended KAPA formulation, including whether PCR ReadyMix or the distinct Library Amplification product.
Obtain provenance for effective buffer parameters or independent experimental calibration before describing a numerical preset as KAPA-validated.
For Q5 and Phusion, keep any future NEB-output calibration separate from KAPA and record exact product/buffer, model, observations and validation error.

implementation_followup.formulation: KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix PCR Kit, KR0370 v16.25
implementation_followup.basis: Published SantaLucia/Owczarzy equations with Roche-disclosed Mg and each-dNTP concentrations; editable assumed monovalent concentration. No PlasmidStudio or other third-party preset was adopted.
implementation_followup.status: Implemented as a conditional Tm estimate, not a calibrated or experimentally validated full KAPA buffer model.
